text:
amira: Nebula dedicated bring-up checklist — need quota bump, autoscale profile, and a load-test window. Proposed plan: 48h priming, 24h steady, 24h soak. Can SRE/Eng confirm feasibility?

jonah: We can run that. Need the exact UTC window, sustained QPS target, and a sample request distribution. Also want a cache-priming run ~2h before the main traffic.

leo: From runtime: recommend sustained 1500 QPS with short spikes to 3000 QPS (10m). Suggested runtime config: batch_size=4, max_concurrency=12, target_latency_p95 <= 250ms. Fallback model: redwood-compat-quant. Reserve ~10% GPU headroom for KV cache warmup.

priya: Confirming customer side: window Mon 2026-03-30 00:00 UTC, 72h total as proposed. We'll provide the traffic profile (percentiles for token lengths) and a service account with KMS access. Do you need anything else from our side?

jonah: Service account with role infra:loadtest + prometheus scrape permissions is enough. I'll post the basic vegeta command we'll run for the steady state: 

```bash
# steady state (example)
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=1500 -duration=24h | vegeta report -type=json > steady_report.json
# spike test (10m bursts)
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=3000 -duration=10m | vegeta report -type=json > spike_report.json
```

jonah: Also plan a 2-hour canary 6h before the main window to validate routing, model variants, and KMS access. Canary will run at reduced QPS (200 qps) and check correctness/e2e traces.

ops-bot: Scheduled load-test job 'nebula-priming' created for 2026-03-30 00:00 UTC by amira. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nebula-priming (ops oncall will be paged).

amira: For quotas: request bump to reserved pool "nebula-pool" -> target 8 GPUs (A100-equivalent) reserved for the window, with 2x burst nodes available if autoscale triggers. Can finance confirm allocation?

leo: Autoscale knobs we should set:
- scale_up: when request_queue_length > 50 for 30s OR avg_gpu_util > 75% for 60s
- scale_down: when request_queue_length < 10 for 5m AND avg_gpu_util < 40%
- cooldown: 3m between scale actions
Set model fallback policy: prefer quantized variant on scale events to avoid OOMs.

priya: We'll open a ticket for the IAM bits and share the sample requests file by EOD Friday. Also confirm KMS key alias we'll provide: projects/nebula/keys/nebula-priming-key.

amira: :thumbsup: Jonah please kick the canary 6h prior and post results here. If the canary fails, hold the main run and we will triage.

jonah: On it. I'll paste canary logs and the prometheus dashboard link to #eng-oncall once it's live. Will also capture a short runbook snippet for rollback (switch traffic to hosted fallback pool).

leo: One more note — set batching_policy.max_wait_ms=12 to avoid latency amplification during spikes.

amira: Thanks all — I'll update the customer-facing timeline and include the escape hatch and postmortem owners.

jonah: ETA for canary prep: 48h. I'll follow up with the exact deploy commands and a short checklist tomorrow.

priya: Great, thanks team. We'll be standing by for the IAM link and traffic file.
